summary: VSee Health, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement with an institutional investor for an unsecured convertible note of $280,000 principal ($30,000 OID, 10% interest charge). The note matures June 22, 2027, is convertible after 180 days into common shares at 85% of the lowest closing price over the prior 10 trading days (floor $0.01), with a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker. The company retains prepayment rights. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; no merger, tender, restructuring, or change-of-control event is involved.
